g.text: PF-N. Event onsets (no event on the issue day, event on the target day): which forecasts warned in time?
Evidence D (panel request). Selected validation example chosen to demonstrate baseline limitations as requested by the thesis panel; not representative of all historical
dates. Event persistence cannot warn of an onset by construction.
Event = study label (24-hour MSLP fall ≥ 3 hPa or wind ≥ 10.8 m/s; every event here is a pressure fall). Hit = warning issued for the onset date. W1+X1 = cross-station mean of W1
probabilities, warning at ≥ 0.601 (threshold adopted after the website results were seen; not an independent test). Event climatology = station × month event frequency 2015-2020 against its
tuning-year threshold. False alarms are counted on all non-event days. Run panel-v3-20261025T104927Z-abfe4c.
